definition: Use the full neutral singlet INT-G C39H34OP2Pd reactant. In its fixed map, Pd75 binds hydrides H76/H77 and P1/P41 of XantPhos. Build the H–H saddle, eta2-H2 adduct, separated H2+Pd(XantPhos), and one DMAc-coordinated Pd regeneration endpoint. Keep the XantPhos graph intact. Use DMAc and 298.15 K. Primary ledger: solutes 1 M and H2 at 1 atm; separately report all-species 1 M and H2 pressure sensitivity. Source 1 atm and all-solute 1 M values cannot be combined.

HH_formation.requirement: Connected H–H formation saddle and bound-H2 endpoint.

release_and_recoordination.requirement: Real separated and re-ligated states, not relabelled eta2-H2.

standard_state_control.requirement: Explicit H2 pressure and gas/solute standard-state conversions.

optional_not_required: 完整光催化回路、精确周转频率不加入。
numeric_reference_status: Not yet calibrated for expanded matrix; no new reference calculation performed.
